fieldHints.auth_enabled: Require an API key or passkey to access the dashboard and API.
fieldHints.developer_mode: Show the Developer section in the sidebar and allow admins to mint dedicated seek_dev_… tokens with full admin scope for third-party API integrations.
fieldHints.hide_auth_off_notice: Hide the sidebar warning shown while authentication is disabled.
fieldHints.history_retention_days: How many days request history is kept before cleanup.
fieldHints.logs_retention_days: How many days logs are kept before cleanup.
fieldHints.usage_retention_days: How long daily search-quota counters are kept before cleanup.
fieldHints.audit_retention_days: How long administrative audit records are kept before cleanup.
fieldHints.max_concurrency: Maximum number of provider requests running at the same time.
fieldHints.max_attempts: Maximum attempts per provider before giving up.
fieldHints.user_agent: HTTP User-Agent header sent to providers.
fieldHints.retry_http_codes: HTTP status codes that trigger an automatic retry.
fieldHints.ap_retry_codes: Provider error codes that trigger an automatic retry.
fieldHints.public_origin: Public base URL of this instance, used for passkeys.
fieldHints.rp_id: WebAuthn relying party ID (the domain for passkeys).
fieldHints.rp_name: WebAuthn relying party name shown to users.
fieldHints.log_level: Log verbosity: debug, info, warn or error.
fieldHints.treat_empty_as_fail: Count an empty result set as a failed attempt.
fieldHints.ignore_request_count: Ignore the requested result count and return everything found.
fieldHints.allow_sparse_sources: Answer-node sources (link+title, often without a snippet) are added to the Row result.
fieldHints.search_rate_limit_per_minute: Per-key search requests allowed per minute on /search and /mcp (0 = unlimited).
fieldHints.search_daily_quota: Per-key search requests allowed per UTC day (0 = unlimited).
fieldHints.chain_timeout_seconds: Hard wall-clock limit for one search across all providers (0 disables).
fieldHints.provider_failure_threshold: Consecutive provider failures before it is skipped for a cooldown (0 disables).
fieldHints.provider_cooldown_seconds: How long a failing provider is skipped by the circuit breaker.
fieldHints.update_check_enabled: Fetch the public release feed and show a notice when a newer version is available.
fieldHints.update_check_url: Release API endpoint (GitHub "latest release" by default). Clear to disable.
fieldHints.update_check_interval_hours: How many hours between automatic checks.
fieldHints.webhook_url: POST a JSON payload to this URL on provider circuit-breaker trips and daily quota exhaustion. Empty disables notifications.
